title: Spent most of my trailer time on the audio, then found out Steam autoplays it muted
author: luckyriver151
selftext:
Solo dev here, small 2D platformer in Godot with Claude doing most of the coding. Steam page goes up next month so I've been putting together the first trailer, about a minute of gameplay recorded in-engine with the HUD off.

I spent way more time on the sound than on anything else. Then I read that the first trailer on a store page autoplays muted for most people. So the part everyone sees first has no audio at all lol. Reworked the start so it works on mute, gameplay straight away and the logo moved to the end.

The sound still matters for YouTube and the press emails, so it wasn't wasted. It was just in the wrong place in my head.

I'd tried putting one of my in-game loops under it and it just sat there, since a loop has no idea where anything happens. Ended up doing the trailer music and sfx in Sonilo. The sfx were the big win. It puts the landings and pickups right on the frames they happen and gives them to you as their own layer, so I could pull the music down under the heavy landings. Made the end card sting from a text prompt too.

Since it's all AI audio it's going in my Steam AI disclosure. Didn't realize trailers count until I actually read the rules.

Are you doing separate cuts for the store page and socials, or one trailer for everything?
